title: The internet is having a field day with Amazon's 'About You' customer dossiers. Here's how to see yours.
key_facts: Amazon's "About You" feature shows shoppers an editable list of preferences Amazon has inferred about them.
Amazon introduced it in May 2026 as part of a wider AI shopping push.
Amazon says the inferences come from purchases, searches, saved lists, reviews and conversations with its Alexa for Shopping assistant.
It is trending on social media, especially Threads, because users share blunt or odd entries such as "has cats" and "uses phone in the shower to read Kindle books".
Users can view, edit or remove entries; it is in the Shopping app, mobile web and desktop.
Business Insider reporters checked their own profiles with mixed accuracy.
quote_evidence: The e-commerce giant launched its "About You" feature — basically a customer dossier — earlier this year
With a few clicks, shoppers can pull up Amazon's profile of them, see the conclusions it has drawn, and correct or remove details they don't want shaping their recommendations.
Several Business Insider reporters spent Tuesday morning checking their own profiles.
why_it_matters_hint: Gives shoppers an unusually direct look at what an AI recommendation system has inferred about them.
event_date: Feature launched May 2026; social-media trend 6 Oct 2026
notes: Feature itself is older than 6 Oct; the new item is the viral attention, so freshness NEW.
